system.name: FluentSpeech
system.one_liner: Stutter-oriented automatic speech editing: a context-aware diffusion denoiser with a stutter predictor edits stuttered speech from the transcript.

content.variant_note: (a) thin overview with the denoiser as one green box, (b) the diffusion chain unrolled over spectrogram thumbnails, (c) the denoiser opened up next to its conditioning frame
content.argues: A context-aware diffusion denoiser, conditioned on text, speaker, pitch, duration and stutter information, regenerates a masked span of the mel-spectrogram, and a stutter predictor locates the span automatically.
content.subject: FluentSpeech overview, the reverse diffusion chain over spectrograms, and the wiring of the context-aware spectrogram denoiser and its conditioning.

elements.name: Phoneme
elements.role: phoneme sequence of the transcription
elements.drawn_as: plain text at the bottom with an upward arrow

elements.name: Phoneme Embedding
elements.role: embeds the phonemes
elements.drawn_as: peach rounded box with thick black outline

elements.name: Transformer Encoder
elements.role: linguistic encoder that turns phonemes into the text hidden sequence e_p
elements.drawn_as: peach rounded box with thick black outline

elements.name: x_t, t, e_p, e_x, ..., e_pitch
elements.role: inputs of the denoiser: noisy spectrogram, diffusion step, phoneme, acoustic and pitch embeddings
elements.drawn_as: serif italic symbols under upward arrows into the green box

elements.name: Context-Aware Spectrogram Denoiser
elements.role: diffusion denoiser that regenerates the masked mel-spectrogram under the context c
elements.drawn_as: pale green rounded box with thick outline; arrows in from a Mask spectrogram and out to an edited one

elements.name: Reverse Diffusion
elements.role: denoising chain from x_T to x_0 with f_theta(x_t | t, c)
elements.drawn_as: pale green frame with bold title, formula, three stacked spectrograms and upward arrows

elements.name: x_0, x_t, x_T
elements.role: indices of the chain: clean result at the top, noisy start at the bottom
elements.drawn_as: italic labels at the right of the stack with vertical dots between

elements.name: Spectrogram Denoiser theta
elements.role: the denoising network opened up
elements.drawn_as: peach frame with bold title

elements.name: Conv 1 x 1 + Relu (input)
elements.role: input projection of x_t
elements.drawn_as: two small light-yellow boxes at the bottom

elements.name: FC + Swish with positional encoding of t
elements.role: turns the diffusion step t into an embedding that is added to the stream
elements.drawn_as: light-yellow box above a circled plus with a circled sinusoid glyph, line into the residual stream

elements.name: Residual Block (N x)
elements.role: repeated block: Conv 3 x 3, gated unit (tanh and sigma with an element-wise product), two Conv 1 x 1 giving residual out and skip out
elements.drawn_as: blue-grey rounded box holding small light-yellow boxes, circled operators and skip lines

elements.name: Conv 1 x 1 + Relu (output) and Predicted x_0
elements.role: sums the skip outputs and predicts x_0
elements.drawn_as: two light-yellow boxes at the top with an arrow up to the text Predicted x_0

elements.name: Context Conditioning c
elements.role: the condition c assembled from the embeddings below and fed into the residual blocks
elements.drawn_as: pale grey frame with bold title

elements.name: Speaker Embedding
elements.role: speaker identity vector
elements.drawn_as: row of narrow tall outlined cells

elements.name: Masked Mel Embedding
elements.role: embedding of the masked acoustic features, added to the condition
elements.drawn_as: row of narrow tall cells, hatched where masked

elements.name: Stutter Embedding
elements.role: frame-wise stutter label (0 normal, 1 stutter) turned into an embedding
elements.drawn_as: five blue cells with the digits 0 1 1 0 0

elements.name: Stutter Predictor
elements.role: text-guided predictor that locates stutter regions from the text and mel embeddings; used only on spontaneous speech (caption)
elements.drawn_as: light-blue rounded box with dashed black outline and dashed lines

elements.name: Mel Embedding
elements.role: mel-spectrogram embedding fed to the stutter predictor
elements.drawn_as: row of narrow tall outlined cells

elements.name: Masked Pitch Predictor, Masked Pitch
elements.role: predicts the pitch of the edited frames from the text embedding and the masked pitch
elements.drawn_as: peach box above orange cells, two cells hatched

elements.name: Masked Duration Predictor, LR, Masked Duration
elements.role: predicts durations; the length regulator expands the phoneme embedding to frame level
elements.drawn_as: peach box, a circle labelled LR, yellow cells with one hatched

elements.name: Phoneme Embedding (c)
elements.role: phoneme embedding entering the duration path
elements.drawn_as: three cells, red, blue and green

elements.name: circled plus
elements.role: adds the context streams into c and the stream parts inside the denoiser
elements.drawn_as: circled plus nodes joined by orthogonal lines

new_tags.what: a flat grey block labelled Mask laid over part of a spectrogram or image thumbnail, with coloured boundary lines, to mark the span to generate or edit

lessons.what_to_learn: Give the model three zoom levels in lettered panels: a thin overview with the focal module in a distinct fill, the same module unrolled as a vertical chain of data thumbnails, and an expanded wiring view split into network and conditioning frames; mark optional paths with dashed lines explained in the caption.
lessons.suits: Conditional diffusion or generative editing models for audio or images where thumbnails show the effect and the denoiser's conditioning needs an expanded view.

evidence: The dashed black line denotes that the operation is only executed when the dataset contains spontaneous speeches.
FluentSpeech consists of a linguistic encoder and a context-aware spectrogram denoiser.

summary: FluentSpeech edits stuttered speech automatically: a context-aware diffusion model regenerates a masked span of the mel-spectrogram, and a stutter predictor finds the span to remove. Figure 1 has three lettered panels. (a) is the overall model, drawn bottom-up: phonemes pass a Phoneme Embedding and a Transformer Encoder and, with x_t, t and other embeddings, enter a green Context-Aware Spectrogram Denoiser that turns a masked spectrogram thumbnail into an edited one. (b) unrolls reverse diffusion as three stacked spectrograms from x_T to x_0. (c) opens the denoiser (residual blocks, time embedding) beside a Context Conditioning frame of coloured embedding cells, with a dashed stutter predictor used only for spontaneous speech.

notes: Prior label kept (model-anatomy, overview-plus-zoom). The digest counts no strokes because outlines are filled shapes. Which of the five spectrogram bitmaps sits where is read from the picture; two narrow bitmaps in the digest are probably context strips of the masked spectrograms. Relations inside (c) are summarised: the exact wiring of the sum nodes between the predictors and the residual block is not followed wire by wire. The hatched cells are read as masked positions (the labels say Masked).
